sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
An agent gets stuck when it cannot determine the next valid action or make progress toward its goal.

Unlike an infinite loop, the agent may not repeatedly execute actions. It may simply stop progressing.

### Difference

- Infinite loop: Repeated execution.
- Agent stuck: No meaningful progress or next action.

choices.label: Ignore it and ship anyway
choices.explanation: Skipping detection leaves users exposed and makes root-cause analysis harder later.

choices.label: Add detection signals first
choices.explanation: - No state transitions. - Long idle execution. - Repeated tool errors. - Pending tasks that never complete. - No new output or progress. - Repeated planning without action.

choices.label: Apply a production fix / mitigation
choices.explanation: 1. Validate tool outputs using schemas. 2. Provide clear tool descriptions. 3. Handle expected errors explicitly. 4. Add fallback actions. 5. Ask the user for missing information. 6. Escalate after bounded retries. 7. Use explicit workflow states.

sections.title: 2. Why does it happen?
sections.body:
- Tool returns unexpected output.
- Agent cannot understand an API response.
- Required information is missing.
- Tool execution fails repeatedly.
- Agent state is invalid.
- Planning is too complex.
- Tool descriptions are ambiguous.
- Agent has conflicting objectives.

sections.title: 4. Real-time example
sections.body:
Your booking agent calls:

```python
search_hotels(
    city="Hyderabad",
    check_in="2026-12-01"
)
```

Expected API response:

```json
{
  "hotels": [],
  "status": "success"
}
```

Actual API response:

```json
{
  "error": "Invalid date format"
}
```

The agent does not understand the error and repeatedly tries to interpret it instead of correcting the date or asking for clarification.
